outline: 本課程所為研究所課程，內容包括狀態空間分析，頻域分析，現代數位控制理論分析及控制器設計，應用實例介紹。
schedule:
Week 1-2: Introduction (Ch. 1)
Week 3-4: Discrete-time systems and the z-transform (Ch. 2)
Week 5-6: Sampling and reconstruction (Ch. 3)
Week 7-8: Open-loop discrete-time systems (Ch. 4)
Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10-11: Closed-loop systems (Ch. 5)
Week 12-13: System time-response characteristics (Ch. 6)
Week 14-15: Stability analysis techniques (Ch. 7)
Week 16-17: Digital controller design (Ch. 8)
Week 18: Final Exam
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

Textbook: C. L. Phillips and H. T. Nagle, Digital Control Systems: Analysis & Design, 3/e, Pearson Education, 1998 (滄海圖書代理).
Reference: M. S. Fadali and A. Visioli, Digital Control Engineering: Analysis & Design, Academic Press, 2009.
